scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hesta-codex/shared && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @hesta-codex/web" "npm run dev -w @hesta-codex/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hesta-codex/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hesta-codex/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hesta-codex/api && npm run typecheck -w @hesta-codex/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hesta-codex/shared && npm run build -w @hesta-codex/api && npm run build -w @hesta-codex/web
